parent_objective: design no-training actor-head sensitivity audit for cross-fault fused history signal

public_gates: design separates feature-delta size projection tanh attenuation and action output
design compares wrong-history directions with reset-hidden directions
design includes feature-delta amplification line search
design blocks actor update PPO and promotion
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden fault labels to actor observations
do not treat amplified feature actions as deployed behavior
do not claim closed-loop self-ID proof from actor-head projection alone

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_action_head_coupling: design actor-head sensitivity audit after M710 action_washout
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: opens a new branch to localize whether fused cross-fault history directions are ignored by actor-head projection, tanh saturation, or insufficient feature amplitude
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design-only diagnostic plan, not driver performance, source export, PPO, or promotion
stop_condition: stop before implementation if the design would require actor input changes
stop training because M711 blocked source export and PPO
stop closed-loop claims because this is an actor-head sensitivity design
fallback_plan: if projection washout is expected, design objective/head coupling audit
if tanh saturation is expected, design action-range or normalization audit
if feature amplitude is too small, design feature amplification objective before actor update
if amplified directions still do not affect outcome, return to terminal-boundary scenario refinement

hypothesis: A no-training actor-head sensitivity audit can determine why M710 fused wrong-history feature differences do not produce action differences.
success_criteria: pre-tanh actor-head projection metrics are specified
tanh derivative attenuation metrics are specified
feature-delta amplification line search is specified
actor behavior and input contract are unchanged
no objective update actor update PPO or promotion is admitted
failure_criteria: design treats amplified counterfactual actions as deployed behavior
design omits projection or tanh attenuation
design admits training before no-training audit
decision_rule: M712 passes only as a design for a no-training actor-head sensitivity audit; it must not admit actor update PPO or promotion.
